goal: Travel from Pewter City through Mt Moon to reach Cerulean City.

subgoals.goal_text: Visit the Pewter City Pokemon Center to ensure the party is fully healed before heading to Route 3.
Purchase Potions at the Pewter City Mart to sustain the party through Mt Moon.
Leave Pewter City and enter Route 3.
Travel east across Route 3 to reach the entrance of Mt Moon.
Navigate through the first floor of Mt Moon and descend to the basement (B1F).
Navigate through the B1F and descend further to the bottom floor (B2F).
Locate and defeat the Super Nerd guarding the fossils on B2F.
Find the exit of Mt Moon and emerge onto Route 4.
Travel west across Route 4 to reach Cerulean City.
